nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Professor Bann sent word you'd be coming. Let me just check the list...

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Oh dear. I'm afraid your room isn't ready yet. Today's arrivals all came at once, and we're still sorting the keys.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Why not go and get familiar with the campus in the meantime? Meet your fellow dormmates. Most of them are out and about today.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Come back once you've had a good look around, and I'll have your key waiting.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: No room yet? Guess exploring it is, then.

metadata.value: Chapter 1 story beat, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: That's a lot of new faces and a lot of strange puzzles for one day.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: My dorm room should be ready by now. I should head back to the dormitory.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: {player}! Perfect timing. Your room is ready at last.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Here's your key. Third door along the hall, right in the middle. You can't miss it.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: I really hope it's big enough for the five of us. Then again, this is a magical academy, so I feel like I don't need to worry about that.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Get some rest. Tomorrow your student guide will show you everything you missed.
